image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a common iguana (Iguana iguana). The image focuses on the head, neck, and upper torso. Visible features include a prominent dorsal crest with sharp spines, a large subtympanic shield (circular scale) below the ear area, textured granular scales on the green body, and larger plate-like scales on the greyish head. A dewlap is visible hanging from the throat. There is faint, gibberish text in the top-left corner.
